name: LegacyLedger
mechanic: The more you trade, the higher your onchain loyalty tier. 0.05% of each trade to the treasury.
plain: Every trade pays 0.05% to the treasury and earns you a loyalty mark. Those marks add up over time and move you into higher loyalty tiers. The more you trade, the higher your standing - status that builds up and stays recorded onchain.
rules: Every trade pays 0.05% to the treasury and earns a loyalty mark.
Marks accumulate into higher loyalty tiers over time.
Your standing is recorded permanently onchain.

fee.note: 0.05% of each swap to the treasury
